preconditions.description: A dedicated non-interactive workload identity exists for worker processes, distinct from the API runtime login, with its issuance and rotation evidenced.
Every external provider a worker could invoke has an approved adapter with verified data-governance terms (residency, retention, no-training) recorded before any invocation path is mounted.
Worker-initiated provider spend settles against the approved budget authority with worst-case pre-reservation, mirroring the AI gateway's reservation discipline.
Outbox deliveries are only ever marked delivered against an independently verified provider receipt; no delivery is inferred from a successful request.
The human-session worker control router stays unmounted and unpublished until the preceding preconditions carry evidence and a named human records the mounting decision.
